messages:
maya: Quick sync — PR #16982 (bridge/routing-cache) is ready from my side but it's stuck on mac-e2e flakiness. Need one more approval to land before the deploy-freeze (Fri 23:00 UTC). Can APAC folks sign off earlier or should we wait for EU window? cc @sven @dana

sven: I can eyeball it now, quick pass only — I'm offline after 10:30 PDT though. If it's minor I can approve.

maya: Thanks. The failing CI log shows a device timeout in the mac runner:```Error: timeout waiting for device: iPhone-12-sim``` Seems flaky, not a code change.

ci-bot: mac-e2e: failed on job 4821 with exit code 1 (timeout). To retrigger, comment `/retest`.

prim: Seen that flake on a different PR earlier today. Two options: (1) rerun CI once infra clears (usually good), (2) set `E2E_PARALLEL=1` env to reduce concurrency on runner. Leaning rerun first.

maya: I don't want to change job config for a single PR. I'll request a rerun. @dana can you do a rerun in the 08:00 UTC slot if infra is still flaky? That would give APAC a chance to review before freeze.

dana: I can kick a rerun at 08:00 UTC and monitor. If it passes, we should aim to canary in eu-west at 09:00 UTC and then merge.

alex: Quick review note: tiny comment about the migration doc, otherwise code looks good from product side.

maya: Fixed the migration comment and pushed. @sven if you're ok please approve so we have 2 reviewers.

sven: +1 from me, approving now :thumbsup:

ci-bot: mac-e2e: rerun triggered by @dana. Rerun completed: success. All checks green.

maya: Awesome — plan: merge after the 09:00 UTC canary window (monitoring for 15m). If regression, we'll rollback and reopen. I'll add a short note in #release-notes and ping ops. Thanks for the quick help everyone.

prim: Nice — thanks for coordinating. One follow-up: can we add a short note to the CI infra ticket about intermittent mac sim timeouts so infra can triage? I'll file it after lunch.

maya: Good call, please do. I'll mark this PR as "staged-canary" and add the freeze-safe tag.

alex: Thanks — happy path confirmed.

sven: Logged off but saw it passed, nice work.

maya: Closing this thread once merged. Will ping if anything weird shows up during canary.
